title: Segments of a Circle Assessment
description: Show mastery of circular segments, sectors, and segment area calculations.

questions.question: A shaded region is bounded by a chord AB and the minor arc AB. What is the region called?
questions.explanation: A circular segment is bounded by a chord and its intercepted arc.

questions.question: A shaded region is bounded by radii OA and OB and arc AB. What is the region called?
questions.explanation: A sector is bounded by two radii and an arc.

questions.question: To find the area of a minor circular segment, you can subtract the area of the triangle formed by the two radii and the chord from the sector area.
questions.explanation: The minor segment is the part of the sector left after removing the triangle.

questions.question: A sector has area 96 square units. The triangle inside it has area 70 square units. What is the segment area?
questions.explanation: Segment area = sector area - triangle area = 96 - 70 = 26 square units.

questions.question: A sector has area 120 cm^2, and its triangle has area 85 cm^2. Enter the segment area in cm^2.
A circle has radius 12. What is the area of a 90-degree sector?
questions.explanation: A 90-degree sector is one fourth of the circle, so its area is (1/4)pi(12)^2 = 36pi.

questions.question: A 90-degree sector in a circle of radius 12 contains a right triangle with legs 12 and 12. What is the exact area of the minor segment?
questions.explanation: The sector area is 36pi. The triangle area is (1/2)(12)(12) = 72. The segment area is 36pi - 72.

questions.question: A 60-degree sector has area 24pi square units. The triangle inside it has area 36 square units. Enter the exact segment area.
questions.explanation: Use segment area = sector area - triangle area, so the exact area is 24pi - 36.

questions.question: The straight boundary of a circular segment is a radius.
questions.explanation: The straight boundary of a circular segment is a chord. A radius is used as a boundary in a sector.

questions.question: A circle has radius 10 and a 72-degree sector. What is the sector area?
A student finds the sector area and stops. Explain why this may not answer a segment area question.
questions.correctAnswer: The sector includes both the triangle formed by the two radii and the circular segment. To find the segment area, subtract the triangle area from the sector area.
questions.explanation: The segment is only the cap-shaped part, not the entire sector.

questions.question: A 90-degree sector has area 25pi square units. The triangle inside the sector has base 10 and height 10. Find the exact segment area and explain your steps.
questions.correctAnswer: The triangle area is (1/2)(10)(10) = 50. The segment area is sector area minus triangle area, so the exact segment area is 25pi - 50 square units.
questions.explanation: First compute the triangle area, then subtract it from the given sector area.
